text: A working claims object is tempting to over-promise on. This lesson draws a hard line around what V1 actually ships.
V1 ships the Warranty_Claim__c object, its security model, auto-routing by region, and reporting for Service leadership.
V1 does not rebuild Cascade Ridge's broader org, and does not touch Opportunities, Leads, or the sales process.
A customer self-service portal is a real idea -- deferred on purpose as V2, not dropped.
Marisol Fontaine and Renée Castellano both signed off on this boundary. Next: designing the Warranty_Claim__c object itself, field by field.
